_comment: Phase 1 base pool (2026-06-11). Membership criterion is OBJECTIVE LIQUIDITY ONLY: US-listed common stocks among the largest/most-traded names (mega/large-cap, deep options/volume, tight spreads), sector-diverse. The trading universe is the top UNIVERSE_TOP_N of this pool by 6-1 momentum, recomputed weekly by rule (src/universe.py). NEVER add/remove names here based on how they performed in a backtest — that is exactly the survivorship bias this pool exists to kill.
_etfs_comment: Sector ETFs added 2026-08-05 on the SAME liquidity-only criterion as everything else above (all clear MIN_DOLLAR_VOL by orders of magnitude). They are here to fix POSITION GRANULARITY, not to chase performance: on a $10k account with a 20% per-name cap, one share of a $1,400 pool member is 14% of the book and the ATR-derived share count floors to 1 or 0, so the risk model stops working. One ETF per sector already represented in the pool, unleveraged only — 2x/3x funds are deliberately excluded (daily rebalancing decays them over the 10-day max hold, and their momentum would dominate the ranking for the wrong reason). Listing a ticker below marks it as an ETF for universe.py's reserved-slot sleeve (UNIVERSE_ETF_SLOTS, default 0 = inert).
